title: "Request Help with Community Cats"
---

Please complete the form below to request help with a community cat. We are not able to respond to requests that do not accompany a completed form.

[Request Form](https://form.jotform.com/233584882215159){.main-button}

```{=html}
<div class="jotform-wrapper">

<iframe
  id="JotFormIFrame-233584882215159"
  title="Request Form"
  allowtransparency="true"
  allow="geolocation; microphone; camera; fullscreen"
  src="https://form.jotform.com/233584882215159"
  frameborder="0"
  style="
    min-width:100%;
    max-width:100%;
    height:1200px;
    border:none;
  "
  scrolling="no">
</iframe>

</div>

<script type="text/javascript">
var ifr = document.getElementById("JotFormIFrame-233584882215159");

if (ifr) {
  window.addEventListener("message", function(e) {
    if (typeof e.data === 'string' && e.data.indexOf("setHeight") > -1) {
      var height = e.data.split(":")[1];
      ifr.style.height = height + "px";
    }
  }, false);
}
</script>
    
```

::: callout-important
**Please note:** Cleveland Community Cat Project is an all-volunteer organization. Our volunteers donate their time without compensation because they care about cats and their community. We have zero tolerance for abusive, threatening, harassing, or disrespectful behavior toward our volunteers. If you engage in this type of conduct, we will end all communication and decline to provide assistance. Our priority is protecting our volunteers so they can continue helping cats.
:::
